policy: For generic droid/trooper roles, prefer ordinary exact-role physical candidates over region-, unit-, rank-, owner-, or holiday-specialized variants. Specialized candidates can support the broader family but do not define the base digital identity. Multiple ordinary pre-game construction generations remain visual/component pending.

records.reason: The generic BattleDroid source key should map first to an ordinary battle-droid family rather than to Geonosian, Kashyyyk, rocket, or commando specializations. The long-running two-bent-arms physical family supplies ordinary pre-game support; exact digital-to-physical component equivalence still requires visual comparison.

systemic_findings: Generic droid/trooper keys should preferentially resolve to ordinary role families, not higher-scoring regional, rank, owner, or festive specializations.
A prelaunch physical release can still be semantically unsuitable for a base role when it is explicitly a specialized Hoth or other regional variant.
Exact-name later figures do not supersede earlier ordinary physical families when they postdate the game corpus.
